components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink action for secondary and utility actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; background: #121212; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #121212; font: 600 13px/1 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.25s, color 0.25s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6a1e2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen, such as Shop puffer jackets or Add to bag.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; background: #6a1e2b; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #6a1e2b; font: 600 13px/1 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #521722; border-color: #521722; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6a1e2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Secondary action such as Shop all categories or Size guide.
components.css: .ds-link-text { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; font: 600 13px/1 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #121212; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #121212; } .ds-link-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6a1e2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Size Chip
components.description: A selectable size. Selected chips invert to an ink fill.
components.css: .ds-size { min-width: 56px; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #121212; background: #ffffff; color: #121212; font: 500 14px/1 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-size[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #121212; color: #ffffff; } .ds-size:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6a1e2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Photograph
components.description: A fixed-ratio photograph with a stone ground and a caption below. Stock photos are labelled.
components.css: .ds-photo { margin: 0; } .ds-photo-box { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #f5f3ef; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; } .ds-photo-box img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-photo figcaption { margin-top: 10px; font: 400 13px/1.5 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5f5b56; }

narrative.overview: The store is a calm, bright rail of outerwear. Photographs of real people in winter clothing carry the product story. Everything else steps back: ink type on white, stone and tint bands between sections, and one oxblood accent that marks only the action the visitor should take next. It is the category standard, played straight and built to the bar of premium US outerwear sites. Premium comes from restraint, even grids, precise type and motion that explains rather than decorates.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on white, with stone and tint bands and one oxblood accent.
Marcellus display headlines; Figtree UI in small, uppercase, tracked labels.
Square corners, hairline dividers, no shadows.
Real photography for every category and every product, labelled as stock photos until the store's own photography is supplied.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Oxblood marks the single action a visitor should take on a screen. It never decorates, and checkmarks and icons stay ink.

rules.name: The Honest Photo Rule
rules.body: Every photograph is labelled as a stock photo on product pages. A photograph never implies a real product, price, rating or stock level.

rules.name: The Measured Headline Rule
rules.body: Display never exceeds 4.9rem (78px), and headlines always wrap with balanced lines.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Separation comes from rules and tone, never from shadow.

dos: Do use one oxblood action per screen (#6a1e2b).
Do keep headlines in Marcellus at weight 400 and balance their lines.
Do label every stock photograph on product pages with "Stock photo".
Do keep forms and bag controls flat, with 1px ink borders.
Do use the named type scale. Add a new step to DESIGN.md before using a new size.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or blur.
Don't introduce a second accent colour.
Don't draw line illustrations in place of photographs.
Don't invent prices, ratings, stock or review counts in copy or structured data.
Don't use rounded corners or pill shapes.
Don't centre long body copy; keep the 65ch measure.
